The '''Imperial Monitoring Garrison''' was a military installation located within [[Base Tekar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. [[Friends of Paran]] [[operative]] [[Pter Venteck]] worked in the facility, and helped an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team to infiltrate it during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
